integrity: An elementary all-parameter algebraic proof and two independent reproducible finite checks are provided. The novelty assessment is qualified by explicit prior-work risks. No independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only finite characteristic-two fields and simple undirected complements of spanning unions of cycles are covered.
First-entry times and total periodic populations are classified; primitive eventual periods and individual orbit-basin sizes are not.
Finite verification programs are supporting tests, not proof of the unbounded theorem.
Literature comparisons cannot rule out inaccessible or unindexed equivalent statements.
title: A cubic-resonance transient law for parity dynamics on complements of spanning 2-factors
